sloka: वरदानकृतत्राणे सा गदा रावणोरसि ।दुर्बलेव यथावेगं द्विधाभूत्वा ऽपतत्क्षितौ ।। ७.३२.६१ ॥
transliteration: varadānakṛtatrāṇe sā gadā rāvaṇorasi ।durbaleva yathāvegaṁ dvidhābhūtvā 'patatkṣitau ।। 7.32.61 ॥

translations.english: That mace, striking Ravana's chest which was protected by boons, split into two and fell to the ground as if it were weak, despite its full force.
